Faq.title: Frequently asked questions
Faq.description: Key answers about the platform, safety and deployment.

what.question: What is MOLARYA UZ?
what.answer: MOLARYA UZ is a virtual chemistry laboratory and learning platform for students, teachers and schools. It combines theory with interactive experiments, 3D molecules and an AI assistant.

safe.question: Is the virtual laboratory safe?
safe.answer: Yes. Experiments are modelled in the browser and no real reagents are used. However, virtual results do not replace real laboratory safety rules.

languages.question: Which languages are available?
languages.answer: The interface works in Uzbek (Latin), Russian and English. You can switch language from any page.

school.question: How is the platform deployed in a school?
school.answer: The school plan includes teacher and class dashboards, assignment management and centralised analytics. Deployment is phased and supported by onboarding.

ai.question: Can I trust AI answers?
ai.answer: The AI tutor is a learning aid and can make mistakes. Important chemistry information should be verified with a textbook, teacher or reviewed scientific source.

free.question: Can I use it for free?
free.answer: Yes, the Starter plan is free for exploring the platform. The full laboratory and courses are available on Premium.

devices.question: What devices are required?
devices.answer: A modern browser and an internet connection are enough. A WebGL-capable device is recommended for 3D molecules; a 2D view is provided without WebGL.

data.question: How is data protected?
data.answer: The platform follows minimal collection of user data and role-based access principles. The full privacy policy will be published with the backend integration.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.description: How MOLARYA UZ processes data and how it stays protected.
privacy.metaDescription: MOLARYA UZ privacy policy — how data is collected and protected.
privacy.updated: Last updated: January 1, 2026. Drafted for demo purposes.
privacy.intro: This privacy policy is shown in demo mode and describes the pre-launch stage. A full data policy will be reviewed before launch.

collect.title: Data we collect
collect.body: In Phase 1 the site stores only technical data (your language choice via a cookie). Newsletter and contact forms are not sent to a real server and stay in your browser only. Account data processing will be introduced when the backend connects in Phase 2.

use.title: How data is used
use.body: Collected data is used only to run the platform, remember language settings and demonstrate features. We do not share your data with third parties for advertising.

storage.title: Storage and security
storage.body: In demo mode data lives only in your browser (localStorage). Once the server side is connected, encryption and infrastructure compliant with the law of Uzbekistan will be applied.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You may request to view, correct or delete your data. Requests are accepted at hello@molarya.uz.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: For privacy questions, write to hello@molarya.uz.
